findings.title: Live direct_buyable CTAs lack enforced browser_truth recency
constitution_refs: §5 Truth Contract — evidence outranks memory; corrections improve truth
§7 Evidence Standards — point-in-time checks are not permanent truth
findings.summary: **PROVEN:** `buyLinkGateFailureKind` allows `direct_buyable` rows regardless of `browser_truth_checked_at` age. **PROVEN:** R1 shadow instrumentation (`staleBrowserTruthShadowClassification`, `buckparts:stale-browser-truth-shadow`) counts stale rows without suppressing CTAs or `/go`. **INFERRED:** Wrong-part / wrong-listing risk rises when PDP truth ages without re-check.
findings.proven_gap: No enforcing gate ties live buy-path authority to browser-truth recency. A row can remain `direct_buyable` with missing or 90+ day old `browser_truth_checked_at` and still win CTA selection and `/go` redirects.
findings.false_safety_risk: Operators may assume `direct_buyable` implies recently verified browser truth. Shadow report showing `stale_shadow_count: 0` at one snapshot does not prove future safety — only current DB recency at the 90-day threshold.
findings.smallest_safe_fix: Phase 1 (done): shadow/count only via `R1_SHADOW_STALE_BROWSER_TRUTH_MAX_AGE_MS` and read-only report. Phase 2 (not started): owner-approved enforcement — add `stale_browser_truth` to `buyLinkGateFailureKind` or demote stale primaries before CTA selection; run parity on AP stale-primary cohort first.

blast_radius.30d: **INFERRED:** Stale PDP pricing/stock/variant drift on live CTAs; shadow count rises; homeowners reach outdated destinations.
blast_radius.60d: **INFERRED:** Cumulative wrong-code exposure across wedges; audit reports understate risk if shadow report not re-run.
blast_radius.90d: **PROVEN policy threshold:** Rows older than `R1_SHADOW_STALE_BROWSER_TRUTH_MAX_AGE_MS` classify as stale in shadow mode; without enforcement, CTAs still live.

findings.title: HQ handoff freshness test validates presence, not HEAD or recency
constitution_refs: §7 Evidence Standards — discovery is not closure
findings.summary: **PROVEN:** `scripts/buckparts-hq-handoff-freshness.test.ts` checks 120 substring needles in `docs/BuckParts-HQ-HANDOFF.md` via `source.includes(needle)` only. **PROVEN:** Test header admits it does not validate commit hashes. **PROVEN:** Test passes at `bc29506` while handoff executive checkpoint is `c780e82` (7 commits behind) and while required needle `afaf86d` is a superseded grant milestone (2026-05-29).
findings.proven_gap: No comparison between `git rev-parse HEAD` and handoff stopping-point tables. Historical milestone strings are required forever — test stays green as handoff drifts. Test id `current_head_afaf86d` enforces grant checkpoint `afaf86d`, not live HEAD.
findings.false_safety_risk: Test name and `docs/BuckParts-RUNNER-STATUS.md` label it a freshness guard. Handoff blocks cite passing this test as validation before commit. Operators and HQ agents may treat green test as current stopping-point truth while §0B lane priority contradicts top AP CSV section.
findings.smallest_safe_fix: Split concerns: (1) keep presence contract as-is; (2) add separate `hq-handoff-head-parity` test parsing top executive checkpoint vs `git rev-parse --short HEAD`; (3) rename `current_head_afaf86d` → `historical_grant_checkpoint_afaf86d`; (4) optional max-age guard on handoff checkpoint date. Do not add more historical hash needles per milestone.

blast_radius.30d: **INFERRED:** ~363 commits potential drift; wrong NBA and obsolete prompts; test still passes if strings retained.
blast_radius.60d: **INFERRED:** Severe — multiple superseded stopping points; grant/AP/WHW narratives conflict; test green.
blast_radius.90d: **INFERRED:** Handoff becomes archaeology; Command Center-only operators safe; HQ-migration agents misled.
